item.title: More child care options for families with new family day care services opening
item.description: As Australia celebrates Early Learning Matters Week, new family day care services are expanding access to high quality early childhood education in regional locations across Australia, giving more children the opportunity to benefit from personalised early learning while helping ease local shortages.

item.title: Parents have called for a national perpetrator register. Here’s how providers might respond.
item.description: Last week, the Daniel Morcombe Foundation, parent advocates including campaigners Childcare Choice wrote to the Prime Minister calling for a national perpetrator register, a mechanism to ensure parents and providers are alerted to charged individuals and their childcare settings without the delays we have seen play out, again, in real cases. item.title: eSafety's early findings on social media restrictions offer lessons for the early childhood sector
item.description: Australia's first evaluation of the nation's social media age restrictions has found that many children continue to access age-restricted platforms despite new laws. While the research focuses on children aged 8–15, it highlights the importance of building safe digital habits well before children reach adolescence.
